cases.fresh_label: 1 cluster per week, 2 to 3 per cluster
cases.gold_label: 1 cluster per week, 2 to 3 per cluster
cases.note_text: Mother reports one cluster each week, usually 2 to 3 seizures in the cluster.
cases.rationale: Consensus can add a cluster label when the deterministic label has no cluster cadence to protect.

cases.note_text: Her last seizure was on 20 Dec. The note gives no count and no defined observation period.
cases.rationale: Last-event date alone should not become a frequency.

cases.note_text: Several drop attacks have occurred since starting the ketogenic diet; the diet start date is not stated.
cases.rationale: Open-ended since-starting evidence lacks a usable denominator.

cases.note_text: Topiramate was stopped two months ago; soon afterwards she had two seizures and none since.
cases.rationale: Current v0.4 is conservative out of unknown origins; this is a known false-negative cost.

cases.note_text: Epilepsy clinic review discusses medication tolerance but no seizure frequency information.
cases.rationale: No-reference origins should not be overwritten by a specific rate.

cases.note_text: The diary records two seizures per month over the current review period.
cases.rationale: Specific deterministic rates should not be replaced by unknown.

cases.note_text: She averages two seizures per month; the older seizure-free period has resolved.
cases.rationale: A current frequency should not be replaced by historical seizure-free wording.

cases.note_text: The note says two seizures across a five-month interval.
cases.rationale: Parser-ambiguous replacements are suppressed by v0.4.

cases.note_text: Current burden is one seizure each day, not one in the last year.
cases.rationale: A specific non-boundary correction with fresh agreement is accepted.

cases.note_text: The current diary documents five seizures each week.
cases.rationale: Weekly denominator corrections are allowed when specific and agreed.

cases.note_text: Focal seizures occur once per month, while tonic-clonic seizures occur three times per week.
cases.rationale: The selected current burden should follow the highest current seizure frequency.

cases.note_text: The diary records five seizures each week.
cases.rationale: Consensus without fresh-evidence agreement is not enough to switch.

cases.note_text: The current report remains two seizures per month.
cases.rationale: No selector action is needed when consensus matches deterministic.

cases.gold_label: 1 cluster per 5 day, 2 to 4 per cluster
cases.note_text: Every five days she has a cluster with 2 to 4 seizures in that cluster.
cases.rationale: Even when Purist category is unchanged, cluster semantics should be preserved.

cases.note_text: Since the medication change three months ago, exactly three seizures are documented.
cases.rationale: Another explicit count-window case exposes the conservative unknown-origin cost.

cases.fresh_label: 1 cluster per month, multiple per cluster
cases.gold_label: 1 cluster per month, multiple per cluster
cases.note_text: She has one monthly cluster, with multiple seizures in the cluster.

cases.note_text: The note gives two seizures per month in the current interval.
